description: Lightweight, free saga/process-manager pattern for EventFlux: in-process-first execution, optional distributed transports, first-class compensating actions and isolated unit testing.
Compile-time saga state generation for EventFlux.Saga: turns a [SagaStateSet] enum into reflection-free SagaState definitions and warns when a persisted state is removed. Requires EventFlux.Saga.
Given/When/Then test harness for EventFlux.Saga: unit-test saga state machines without a database, broker or DI container. Test-framework agnostic.
Entity Framework Core persistence for EventFlux.Saga, built on EfCore.RepositoryPack: durable saga instances with optimistic concurrency.
Durable Entity Framework Core timeline store for the EventFlux.Saga inspector, built on EfCore.RepositoryPack: saga transition history survives restarts and is shared by every node.
RabbitMQ transport adapter for EventFlux.Saga on top of EventFlux.RabbitFlow: sagas publish and receive their events through RabbitMQ without changing the saga definition.
Redis Streams transport adapter for EventFlux.Saga on top of EventFlux.RedisFlow: sagas publish and receive their events through Redis without changing the saga definition.
Built-in observability for EventFlux.Saga: records every saga transition in a timeline and serves it as JSON and a minimal HTML page through ASP.NET Core endpoints.
